The sum of the scores of all players should be zero because each game results in a net score change of zero (one point gained and one point lost). Therefore, the final score of person N can be calculated as the negative sum of the scores of persons 1 to N-1. The repair involves changing the behavior to compute the score of person N as the negative sum of the scores in array A, and outputting this value.
